script.source:
//@version=5
indicator("UCT C3B object probe", overlay = true, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500, max_boxes_count = 500)
var line anchor = na
if na(anchor)
    anchor := line.new(bar_index, close, bar_index, close, color = color.yellow, width = 3)
line.set_xy1(anchor, bar_index - 20, close)
line.set_xy2(anchor, bar_index, close)
var line churn = na
if not na(churn)
    line.delete(churn)
churn := line.new(bar_index - 5, high, bar_index, high, color = color.red, width = 1)
if bar_index >= last_bar_index - 2
    label.new(bar_index, low, text = str.tostring(bar_index), color = color.blue, style = label.style_label_up, size = size.small)
if barstate.islast
    box.new(bar_index - 40, high + 4, bar_index - 35, low - 4, border_color = color.green)
    box.new(bar_index - 30, high + 3, bar_index - 25, low - 3, border_color = color.green)
    box.new(bar_index - 20, high + 2, bar_index - 15, low - 2, border_color = color.green)
    box.new(bar_index - 10, high + 1, bar_index - 5, low - 1, border_color = color.green)
var table t = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 2, border_width = 1)
if barstate.islast
    table.cell(t, 0, 0, "UCT", text_color = color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 0, "PROBE", text_color = color.orange)
    table.cell(t, 0, 1, str.tostring(close, "#.##"), text_color = color.yellow)
    table.cell(t, 1, 1, str.tostring(bar_index), text_color = color.aqua)

whatEachSectionDiscriminates.anchor: IDENTITY UNDER UPDATE - created once on bar 0, then set_xy1/set_xy2 every bar. An engine that re-created it per bar could only show a large id.
whatEachSectionDiscriminates.churn: DELETE + TURNOVER - the previous line is deleted and a new one created on every bar. Exactly one may be alive.
whatEachSectionDiscriminates.labels: A SECOND FAMILY, on the last three bars only, each carrying per-object TEXT that names its own bar_index.
whatEachSectionDiscriminates.boxes: MULTIPLE SIMULTANEOUS OBJECTS of one family, created within a single bar, at four distinct x-spans.
whatEachSectionDiscriminates.table: TABLE STATE - one table created once (a var), four cells written on the last bar only.

paletteMeaning.3: the label's and the box's DEFAULT text colour, which Pine spells color.black

visualFacts.identityIsONEMonotonicCounterSharedByEve: Script order on bar 0 mints anchor=1, churn=2, table=3. Every later object continues the SAME sequence regardless of family: labels 8459/8461/8463, boxes 8464-8467, table cells 8468-8471. There is no per-family id space.
visualFacts.anUpdatedObjectKeepsItsId: `anchor` was created once and moved with set_xy1/set_xy2 on every one of ~8,458 bars. Its id is still 1. The churn line, recreated each bar, is 8462. The two numbers are the discrimination: a re-creating engine cannot show a small id, and an updating engine cannot show a large one.
visualFacts.deleteReallyRemoves: About 8,458 churn lines were created across the history and exactly ONE is alive - dwglines holds two entries, the anchor and the newest churn.
visualFacts.xIsAPositionIntoAPerStudyIndexTable: A primitive stores x as an index into the study's own `_indexes` array - not an absolute bar index and not a timestamp. Here _indexes = [259,264,269,274,279,284,289,294,297,298,299], exactly the eleven model bars some object touches. The anchor's x1=4,x2=10 resolve to model bars 279 and 299, a 20-bar span, which is what `bar_index - 20 .. bar_index` asks for.
visualFacts.coordinatesAreTheVendorsOwnBarValues: Every y is a bar field to the cent: anchor y=770.19=close(299); churn y=772.87=high(299); labels y=761.73/767.45/769.00=low(297/298/299); boxes run y1=776.87=high(299)+4 down to y2=765.00=low(299)-4 stepping by 1 - so a box created on the LAST bar uses THAT bar's high/low even where its x-span sits forty bars back.
visualFacts.barIndexIsAbsoluteOverLoadedHistoryNotTh: The chart model held 300 bars while the label text - str.tostring(bar_index) - reads 8455/8456/8457. Pine's bar_index counts the whole loaded history; the 300 is only what the chart model keeps.
visualFacts.aTableCellReferencesItsTableById: Every cell carries `tid: 3`, the table's own object id, plus col/row. Cells are not nested inside the table record.
visualFacts.aTableIsNotPlacedInPriceSpace: The table record carries `pos: "top_right"` and no coordinates at all - it is pane-anchored, unlike every other family.
visualFacts.defaultLabelAndBoxTextColourIs363A45: Neither the labels nor the boxes set a text colour, and both resolved to palette index 3 = #363A45, which is Pine's color.black.

provenance.note: READ OUT OF TRADINGVIEW'S OWN CHART MODEL IN A LIVE SESSION, not transcribed from pixels and not computed here. The study was added from the Pine Editor, read through the model's own study data source - graphics().dwglines()/dwglabels()/dwgboxes()/dwgtables()/dwgtablecells(), each a Map name -> Map flag -> primitive collection whose `_primitivesDataById` holds the records verbatim - and then REMOVED again; the chart's data-source list was verified back to its pre-capture state and the layout was NOT saved. Colours are the study's own resolved properties().state().palettes.palette_common, so every palette index on a record resolves without guessing. Bars are the main series' own bars().valueAt(i).
